title: MDMA from Bengaluru seized in Kunnamkulam; 23-year-old man arrested
content: Thrissur: In a drug bust in Kunnamkulam, a 23-year-old man from Porkalengad was arrested with 36 grams of MDMA. The accused has been identified as Daniel Pradeep, 23, of Srambikkal House, Porkalengad. Acting on a tip-off, police arrested him on a road near his residence. When he spotted the police, the accused allegedly tried to flee but was apprehended after a struggle. Police seized 36 grams of MDMA from his possession. According to the police, the accused used to purchase MDMA from Bengaluru and sell it in Kunnamkulam.
